summary: Completed full backend + frontend integration testing for Unbound (family-court counselling platform). 17/17 backend pytest tests passed including Claude Sonnet 4.5 chat via Emergent LLM key. All major frontend flows verified: Home hero CTAs, Counsellors directory + booking dialog + success toast, Stories list/like/submit, Resources with category filter, Chat with live AI reply rendered, Contact form, About, Navbar (desktop + mobile menu).

issues: Counsellor card images are stock Pexels photos that do not match the platform's theme. Two of the three images show a beauty/spa salon backdrop ('Belleza Salud Armonia / BODY ZEN SPA' signage) and another shows a person in medical scrubs with a stethoscope. None depict counsellors/therapists. This is jarring for a family-court-counselling advocacy platform and undermines trust. Recommend replacing image_url values in SEED_COUNSELORS with images of therapy sessions, neutral portraits, or warm illustrations consistent with the warm-sand/terracotta/sage design system.

action_items: Replace counsellor seed image_url values — current Pexels photos show a spa salon and medical scrubs, not relevant to family counselling.
(Optional) Consider adding rate-limiting / captcha to /api/contact and /api/stories submission endpoints (public, unauthenticated) before launch.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: all routes properly use /api prefix, MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via {'_id': 0}, async/await used throughout — good.
server.py: chat endpoint correctly uses LlmChat with anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; messages persisted to chat_messages collection; session continuity verified.
server.py: seed_db is idempotent (count==0 guard) — safe across restarts.
server.py: bookings endpoint does not validate preferred_date format (free-form string); consider date validation if backend will surface this to counsellors.
server.py: public POST endpoints (/contact, /stories, /bookings) have no rate-limiting or spam protection — acceptable for MVP but should be addressed before production.
test_credentials: None required — no auth in this build. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY already configured in /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_-prefixed bookings, contact submission, and one TEST_ story (status=pending). One like increment applied to story s-001 via test (acceptable side effect). UI tests also submitted one TEST_ story via the form.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All endpoints under /api prefix; seed data is idempotent; chat endpoint hits real Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM key and can take 5-30s; chat assistant messages use data-testid='chat-msg-assistant-{i}' and user messages 'chat-msg-user-{i}'. Booking submit testid is 'booking-submit-btn' (not 'booking-submit'); contact submit is 'contact-submit-btn'; resource filter buttons are 'resource-filter-{slug}' (e.g. resource-filter-systemic). Mobile nav toggle: 'nav-mobile-toggle'; mobile links: 'nav-mobile-link-{label}'. Story s-001 likes count has been incremented by ~3 across tests; if you assert exact value, account for this.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only a design/content issue: counsellor seed images are inappropriate stock photos and should be replaced.
